author: sauliusgrigaitis
content: And how you are going to compare? By simply comparing total allocations?

author: potuz
content: I'm mostly trying to get detailed information on the heap at different stages: how many states clients keep available? How fragmented memory is? How many allocation or copies during STF? Is head state more contiguous than some other kept state? Etc.

author: sauliusgrigaitis
content: This should be very specific to the client implementation, optimisations etc., so not easy to compare between clients. Let us know if you find something useful by this comparision.

author: potuz
content: I've already found a lot of useful things by this comparison and others about state management on prysm, so I want to check other clients to see if certain techniques are worth it or not

author: sauliusgrigaitis
content: Interesting, let us know when you decide to write about your methodology and results.
